apiVersion: v2
name: incident-replay
description: Helm chart for Incident Replay backend and frontend
version: 0.1.0
appVersion: "1.0"

backend:
  image:
    repository: incident-replay-backend
    tag: latest
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  service:
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 8080
  livenessProbe:
    httpGet:
      path: /healthz
      port: 8080
    initialDelaySeconds: 10
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 5
  readinessProbe:
    httpGet:
      path: /healthz
      port: 8080
    initialDelaySeconds: 5
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 5
frontend:
  image:
    repository: incident-replay-frontend
    tag: latest
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  service:
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 80
  livenessProbe:
    httpGet:
      path: /healthz
      port: 80
    initialDelaySeconds: 10
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 5
  readinessProbe:
    httpGet:
      path: /healthz
      port: 80
    initialDelaySeconds: 5
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 5
ingress:
  enabled: false
  annotations: {}
  hosts:
    - host: incident-replay.local
      paths:
        - path: /
          pathType: Prefix
  tls: []
